$comment: FC17.9(i) (D-CSUBSET-INLINE-ASM) + inline-asm P1 (D-LANG-GNU-EXTENDED-INLINE-ASM-UNSUPPORTED): witnesses the empty-template `__asm__` optimizer barrier end-to-end, in EVERY spelling that is clean-reachable through the GNU section grammar. The `__asm__` keyword lexes, asmStmt and the whole boundary chain parse, the empty template AND the opened-but-empty sections are accepted at semantic, each InlineAsm HIR leaf lowers to a zero-operand side-effecting MirOpcode::CompilerBarrier that emits no instruction, and the program stores/loads a global around the barrier run and returns 42. NOT DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY: P1 widened the grammar to parse GNU's full extended form so an operand-carrying asm could be REFUSED precisely (one S0062, not a 53-message non-recovering cascade), and the same widening ADMITTED the empty-section forms as real barriers — an opened-and-empty section binds nothing, so there is nothing to miscompile. Those forms are runtime-observable behaviour newly admitted, hence a runnable witness rather than only a golden. ★ ONE FORM PER GRAMMAR BRANCH CHAIN, not per spelling: (no tail), ("" : ), ("" : : ), ("" :: ) [fused outputs->inputs], ("" : : : ), ("" ::: ) [fused, then plain clobbers], ("" : ::) [plain outputs, then fused inputs->clobbers], plus `__asm__ inline ("")` for the third qualifier of the order-free qualifier run. The two LABEL-section rules are deliberately absent — a fourth section is ill-formed without `goto` (S0063) and unsupported with it (S0062), so neither is clean-reachable; both are pinned in the diagnostics corpus. ✔MEASURED on gcc 13.3.0 (-O2, -std=gnu17 / -std=gnu2x / -std=c2x): every form here compiles and the program EXECUTES returning 42; `("" ::::)` is REJECTED there (`expected ')' before '::'`), which is the polarity S0063 pins. A single-threaded binary cannot observe compiler reordering, so 42 witnesses the compile+run chain including under the `release` optimizer pipeline (the barriers survive DCE/CSE/LICM). The ordering contract (no load hoisted across the fence) is pinned in the MIR tests where it is observable; the asm->barrier link is pinned in test_mir_lowering_c_subset. ⚠ WHAT THIS EXIT-CODE TEST CANNOT SEE, kept from the original form and now extended to the new one: a DROPPED barrier. A Skip mapping — for any form here, including the newly-admitted empty-section ones — still returns 42 and still passes; barrier PRESENCE is pinned at the MIR tier by a separate lane. What this fixture does witness is that admitting these forms did not break the compile+run chain on any leg or optimizer arm. AGNOSTIC: `__asm__` is pure syntax and CompilerBarrier lowers to nothing on every target, so all four legs run (no gated header). RED-on-disable: drop the `__asm__` keyword/asmStmt rule (P0001 undeclared); drop any boundary rule from the tail chain (the matching line becomes a parse error); make the template non-empty (S0057); put a real operand in any section (S0062).
